run.description: Leaning, arm-pumping run with a flight phase.

jog.description: Easy jog with a small float between steps.

sprint.description: All-out sprint, deep lean and high knees.

sneak.description: Hunched cartoon sneak, high careful steps.

tiptoe.description: Dainty, upright tiptoe on stretched legs.

march.description: Proud parade march, high knees, stiff arm swing.

skip.description: Happy step-hop skip with big arm pumps.

backpedal.description: Nervous walk backward, arms up in front.

hop.description: Springy little hop in place, looping.

jump.description: Wind up, spring high, tuck, land with a squash.

leap.description: Running split leap that sails forward.

land.description: Hard landing: crunch, dazed wobble, stand.

trip.description: Snag, flailing dive, belly-skid, flip over onto the back.

tumble.description: Forward roll that travels, pops up to standing.

slip.description: Banana-peel: feet fly up, thud onto the back.

faceplant.description: Topple forward like a plank, splat, push up to a crouch.

sit-down.description: Lower down, hands back, plop onto the floor.

stand-up.description: Pull the knees in, rock forward, rise.

get-up.description: Kick, rock up, scramble to the feet.

crouch-down.description: Drop into a crouch with a little overshoot.

rise.description: Spring up from a crouch, settle tall.

climb-up.description: Hang → pull up → knee over → stand on the ledge. Ledge is y=0; ends 190 forward.

hop-off.description: Scoot forward off a ledge onto the floor 180 below. Ledge is y=0.

sit-on.description: Back onto a ledge behind and perch. Ledge is y=0; floor is 180 below.

skid-stop.description: Brake out of a run: lean-back skid, dust, wobble, stand.

start-run.description: Rock back, coil, burst into a run (ends on run frame 0).

idle.description: Breathing, settling weight, alive but still.

look-around.description: Shades the eyes, peers forward, then cranes up.

tap-foot.description: Hands on hips, impatient foot tapping.

sleep.description: Asleep on the back, slow breathing.

fidget.description: Scratches head, shifts weight, scuffs a foot.

sit-idle.description: Sitting on the floor, knee bobbing, glancing around.

perch-idle.description: Sitting on a ledge, legs dangling and swinging.

hang-idle.description: Hanging from a ledge by both hands, legs swinging.

point.description: Wind back and jab a finger forward, leaning in.

beckon.description: Come-here curl of the arm, head cocked.

shrug.description: Who knows? Palms up, head tipped.

cheer.description: Jumping for joy, arms in a V.

panic.description: Arms flailing, running on the spot.

dance.description: Four-beat groove: disco point, arm roll, shimmy.

victory.description: Leaping fist-pump, landing with a YES.

push.description: Leaning hard into something, shoving it forward.

pull.description: Leaning back and hauling, stepping backwards.

lift.description: Squat, grab, and hoist something overhead.

kick.description: Big wind-up and a long snapping kick.
